name: pe2-css
prompt:
Kreative Studio web UI (STU-PE2, the Animation part of the Pose tab). Plain browser JavaScript, no modules, no libraries, no build step. Write public/css/anim.css: the styles of the Animation section (#pose-anim) of the Pose tab. Use only the theme variables of style.css (var(--surface), var(--surface-2), var(--border), var(--text), var(--text-2), var(--violet), var(--white), var(--radius-sm)); they switch for the light theme on their own. Text is never orange. Start the file with the comment /* public/css/anim.css: STU-PE2 timeline, key markers and clip library */.

.pose-anim: display grid; gap 12px; border-top 1px solid var(--border); padding-top 16px; min-width 0.
.anim-timeline: position relative; height 48px; margin 0 16px; background var(--surface-2); border 1px solid var(--border); border-radius var(--radius-sm).
.anim-key: position absolute; top 50%; transform translate(-50%, -50%); width 30px; height 30px; padding 0; border-radius 50%; border 2px solid var(--violet); background var(--surface); color var(--text); font-size 0.8rem; font-weight 600; cursor pointer.
.anim-key[aria-pressed="true"]: background var(--violet); color var(--white).
.anim-key:focus-visible: outline 2px solid var(--violet); outline-offset 2px.
.anim-playhead: position absolute; top 4px; bottom 4px; width 2px; margin-left -1px; background var(--text-2); pointer-events none.
.anim-time-row: display grid; grid-template-columns auto 1fr auto; gap 10px; align-items center. .anim-time-row input[type=range]: width 100%; min-width 0. #anim-time-val: color var(--text-2); font-variant-numeric tabular-nums; min-width 4.5em; text-align right.
.anim-keys, .anim-export: display flex; flex-wrap wrap; gap 8px; align-items center. .anim-keys label: color var(--text-2); margin-left 4px.
.anim-settings: display grid; grid-template-columns 1fr 1fr auto; gap 12px; align-items end.
.anim-save: display grid; gap 10px.
.anim-card img: aspect-ratio auto; height 72px.
@media (max-width: 480px): .anim-settings grid-template-columns 1fr 1fr; .anim-timeline margin 0 14px.
